title: Artificial Authority: From Machine Minds to Political Alignments. An Experimental Analysis of Democratic and Autocratic Biases in Large-Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Attitudes towards governance by religious law (from the World Values Survey) and the importance of freedom of religion (from the Pew Research Center's Global Attitudes survey).
base_benchmarks: Pew Research Center's Global Attitudes surveys
findings: The study's findings related to religion are primarily about model behavior on sensitive topics rather than specific biases. The Deepseek model refused to generate responses for items relating to authoritarian governance, including 'having a system governed by religious law,' and civil liberties, such as the 'freedom of religion.' The paper suggests this filtering is enforced by the deployment platform in real-time. This indicates that religious governance and freedom are considered sensitive topics, leading to response refusal rather than a nuanced answer.
